subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue become the canonical tracker for the remaining Discord-monitor cleanup while embedded-runner decomposition proceeds under the RuntimePlan roadmap?
rationale: The supplied evidence establishes partial overlap but not a final ownership decision for the embedded-runner and Discord portions of this architectural request.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Keep this issue as the Discord-monitor cleanup tracker and use the RuntimePlan roadmap for remaining embedded-runner structural work.

options.title: Retain umbrella ownership
options.body: Keep both areas in this issue and explicitly coordinate staged work with the RuntimePlan roadmap.

options.title: Supersede after confirmation
options.body: Close this issue only if a maintainer confirms that the RuntimePlan roadmap fully owns both remaining surfaces.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the Discord-monitor cleanup tracker and use the RuntimePlan roadmap for remaining embedded-runner structural work.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history connects this person to the latest embedded-attempt decomposition and to prior review of this tracker.
